campaign_name: AT-OPT-05 Compact-Instruction Eligibility and Transition Semantics
purpose: Determine whether transition.transition_required unnecessarily forces ordinary gameplay requests onto the full primary narration instruction list, without changing production selection.
executive_summary: Verdict A/PASS. Live provider calls: 0. Production instruction selection was not changed. On the F3 pre-continuation snapshot the attached CTIR is the notice-board examination. resolved_transition is false and state_mutations.scene.scene_id is frontier_gate, but the derived node is a required location_change with both anchors frontier_gate. must_advance_scene copies that flag, so compact stays off. Narrative mode stays action_outcome. The attached step-back rebuild is 80,403 bytes and 78 instructions, admission estimate 26,865. Forcing the existing compact path is 70,263 bytes and 18 instructions, estimate 23,485, a reduction of 10,140 bytes and 3,380 estimate. That estimate is bytes divided by 3 plus 64, not a provider bill. The recorded input remains 22,777. Compact drops visibility, first-mention, and speaker hard rules, so that reduction is not accepted. The same same-scene stamp appears on the milestone look and on the 79 and 79B session bundles. A no-resolution rebuild already selects compact because detach_ctir removes the plan. Synthetic resolved_transition and arrived_at_scene stay required and keep mode transition. Focused tests 15 passed and 3 failed. The failures are the preexisting provider_context_projection, gm_only, and social_context KeyErrors.
